title: Backward-State Policy Is Part of the Learning Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2609.39813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-precision training rounds tensors that the backward pass reads again, often for several gradients; each use can read the forward's rounded value, the original, or a new random rounding. This backward-state policy looks like a memory and precision detail, settled by copy accuracy and final loss. We argue that it is part of the learning algorithm, and that neither check shows whether it is right. Copy accuracy does not decide the outcome: in three pairs of 390M runs with an emulated FP8 backward, training fails when attention's backward reuses the forward's rounded output and succeeds with a new rounding from the same distribution. Even the most accurate copy, the original itself, can be wrong by our reference: the gradient of the forward pass as it actually ran, with gradients passed through rounding unchanged. translated_title: 后向状态策略是学习算法的一部分
translated_abstract: 低精度训练会对张量进行舍入，而反向传播会再次读取这些张量，且往往用于多个梯度的计算；每次使用时可以读取前向传播的舍入值、原始值，或进行一次新的随机舍入。这种后向状态策略看起来像是一个内存和精度层面的细节，通常由副本精度和最终损失来决定。我们认为它实际上是学习算法的一部分，而且这两种检验方式都无法判断其是否正确。副本精度并不能决定结果：在三组采用模拟FP8反向传播的390M参数对比实验中，当注意力机制的反向传播复用前向传播的舍入输出时训练会失败，而从同一分布重新舍入时训练则成功。即使是精度最高的副本——原始值本身——按照我们的参考标准（即前向传播实际运行时的梯度，其中梯度传递过程中的舍入保持不变）也可能是错误的。例如，以低精度存储的归一化输出会输入到两个梯度中：增益的梯度需要原始值，但……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出低精度训练中反向传播读取张量的后向状态策略（复用舍入值、原始值或重新舍入）并非仅仅是内存与精度细节，而是学习算法本身的一部分，且副本精度和最终损失都无法作为判断其正确性的依据。
en_tdlr: The backward-state policy—whether the backward pass reuses the forward's rounded value, the original, or a fresh random rounding—is part of the learning algorithm itself, and neither copy accuracy nor final loss can determine whether it is correct.
